description: Query one of Dataville’s data sources (see list_dataville_sources for valid names) with a keyword string. Use it for facts that should come from a real source — company filings, papers, package metadata, nutrition, census figures — rather than from memory. For edgar, a company name or ticker returns its latest filing with that period’s financials and the trailing twelve months to the same date (metadata.financials_ttm); add a form such as "10-K" or "10-Q" to the keywords to pick one.

keywords.description: Search keywords or identifier for the query

name: search_dataville
title: Search a Dataville data source
